LanguageData.MX_QH_Tempest.label: Tempest
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tempest.description: Qinghe's special resource. It is accumulated by using skills and can be spent to offset damage or unleash powerful abilities.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tempest.comps.0.resourceDescriptio: Qinghe's special resource. It is accumulated by using skills and can be spent to offset damage or unleash powerful abilities.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance.label: Elegance
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance.description: Qinghe's special resource. It is accumulated through combat and skill use, empowering her abilities and increasing Tempest recovery.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance.comps.0.resourceDescripti: Qinghe's special resource. It is accumulated through combat and skill use, empowering her abilities and increasing Tempest recovery.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LongBreath.label: Long Breath
LanguageData.MX_QH_LongBreath.description: When Qinghe would take fatal damage or body-part-destroying damage, if she has any Tempest, that damage is negated, all injuries are repaired, Tempest is cleared, and she gains brief invulnerability and psychic invisibility.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LongBreathDamageImmunity.label: Long Breath Surge
LanguageData.MX_QH_LongBreathDamageImmunity.descripti: A brief damage immunity granted after Long Breath triggers.
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringRegen.label: Clear Flow
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringRegen.description: Automatically heals a small amount of injury every short interval.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LotusShield.label: Flower-God Ward
LanguageData.MX_QH_LotusShield.description: Qinghe is blessed by the Twelve Flower Gods and naturally generates a recoverable shield around herself. Learned score nodes can increase its capacity, speed up regeneration, or add steadfast damage caps.\n\nOutside Flower Divination, taking shield damage briefly delays regeneration; during Flower Divination, the shield can regenerate immediately after taking damage. When the shield breaks, it is temporarily disabled.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QingheStatusGizmo.label: Qinghe Status Display
LanguageData.MX_QH_QingheStatusGizmo.description: Hidden hediff used to display Qinghe's status gizmo.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_YangChunAlly.label: Yangchun Harmony
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_YangChunAlly.description: Bathed in Yangchun's musical intent, steps and mind are tuned into harmony.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_YangChunEnemy.label: Yangchun Suppression
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_YangChunEnemy.description: Suppressed by the sound field; action rhythm is thrown into disorder.
LanguageData.MX_SpringFlow.label: Spring Flow Baptism
LanguageData.MX_SpringFlow.description: Blessed by Qinghe's Spring Flow, gaining improved offense, protection, and pain relief.
LanguageData.MX_AquaMirror.label: Mirror Bloom
LanguageData.MX_AquaMirror.description: Protected by Aqua Mirror. When the mirror disappears, it heals the bearer and retaliates against nearby enemies.
LanguageData.MX_Draining.label: Waterflow Severance
LanguageData.MX_Draining.description: Internal fluids are forcibly drawn out. Without intervention, death by dehydration will soon follow.
LanguageData.MX_DryCorpse.label: Dehydrated
LanguageData.MX_DryCorpse.description: A corpse drained of moisture. It will never rot or desiccate further, as if touched by some supernatural force.
LanguageData.MX_DehydrateDamage.label: Fluid Cycle Disorder
LanguageData.MX_DehydrateDamage.description: Some internal fluid behavior has been disrupted, causing circulatory failure or mechanical malfunction.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Desynced.label: Desynced
LanguageData.MX_QH_Desynced.description: Resonance from Qinghe's instrument disrupts movement and aiming rhythm, greatly reducing movement speed and shooting accuracy.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecree.label: Flower Decree
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecree.comps.0.resourceDescr: Qinghe's charge resource, used to cast Four-Season Flower Mandates.
LanguageData.MX_QH_MeditativeStillness.label: Stillness
LanguageData.MX_QH_MeditativeStillness.description: Hidden Hediff: stores the stillness Qinghe accumulates while meditating at the lotus pond.
LanguageData.MX_QH_MeditativeStillness.comps.0.resour: Qinghe's meditative reserve, accumulated while meditating at the lotus pond.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerResonance.label: Resonance
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineBlessing.label: Flower-God Mercy
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineBlessing.description: When Qinghe would take fatal damage or damage that could destroy a body part, negate the damage, repair all injuries, and gain brief invulnerability and 10 seconds of psychic invisibility. This effect can trigger once every 120 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineBlessingImmunity.label: Divine Response
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineBlessingImmunity.description: Blessed by the Flower God, temporarily immune to all damage.
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineFortune.label: Flower-God Grace
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineFortune.description: Hidden Hediff: unified Qinghe stat proxy.
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineProtection.label: Flower-God Ward
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineProtection.description: Qinghe is protected by the Twelve Flower Gods and naturally generates a shield that blocks damage.\n\nWhen broken, the shield is disabled for 10 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerSigil_RedApricot.label: flower god sigil: red apricot
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerSigil_RedApricot.description: A spring resonance passive. The red apricot flower god protects Qinghe, periodically healing the most severe wound, including permanent injuries.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerSigil_Lotus.label: flower god sigil: lotus
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerSigil_Lotus.description: A summer resonance passive placeholder for dodge, disease, toxin, and pollution immunity hooks. Its full effect has not been implemented yet.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerSigil_Magnolia.label: flower god sigil: magnolia
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerSigil_Magnolia.description: An autumn resonance passive placeholder for psychic invisibility, psychic sensitivity, and entropy loss hooks. Its full effect has not been implemented yet.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerSigil_RedPlum.label: flower god sigil: red plum
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerSigil_RedPlum.description: A winter resonance passive placeholder for cold tolerance and freeze accumulation hooks. Its full effect has not been implemented yet.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContract.label: Luoshen contract
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContract.description: Hidden state: records the Luoshen contract binding between Qinghe and her spouse.
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.label: spring flow blessing
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.description: Bathed in spring flow, gaining <color=#FF69B4>increased melee and ranged damage, reduced incoming damage, and reduced pain</color>.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDance.label: flower dance
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDance.description: Qinghe enters Flower Dance, improving movement speed, dodge, and Flower Decree recovery. Divine Protection begins recharging immediately after being hit.
